Messages.Author: dancingmummy
Messages.Body:
If the opposing minion plays Thrown Gate during the maneuver phase, do
I play superior The Jones then to cancel the strike card being played,
or do I wait until the strike phase to play the card (thus canceling
the strike)?

thanks,
dancingmummy

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Play it when the card is played.

--
